verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              पार्थः प्राप्य धनुः श्रेष्ठमक्षय्यौ च महेषुधी। रथं ध्वजं सभां चैव युधिष्ठिरमभाषत॥१॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said Having obtained that best of bows (Gandiva) and the couple of inexhaustible quivers and the car and the (ape standard) flagstaff, Arjuna spoke to Yudhishthira thus.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच।
              धनुरस्त्रं शरा वीर्यं पक्षो भूमिर्यशो बलम्। प्राप्तमेतन्मया राजन्दुष्प्रापं यदभीप्सितम्॥२॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said Having obtained that best of bows (Gandiva) and the couple of inexhaustible quivers and the car and the (ape standard) flagstaff, Arjuna spoke to Yudhishthira thus.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र कृत्यमहं मन्ये कोशस्य परिवर्धनम्। करमाहारयिष्यामि राज्ञः सर्वान्नृपोत्तम॥३॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said Having obtained that best of bows (Gandiva) and the couple of inexhaustible quivers and the car and the (ape standard) flagstaff, Arjuna spoke to Yudhishthira thus.

verses.sanskrit: विजयाय प्रयास्यामि दिशं धनदपालिताम्। तिथावथ मुहूर्ते च नक्षत्रे चाभिपूजिते॥४॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said Having obtained that best of bows (Gandiva) and the couple of inexhaustible quivers and the car and the (ape standard) flagstaff, Arjuna spoke to Yudhishthira thus.

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              धनञ्जयवचः श्रुत्वा धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। स्निग्धगम्भीरनादिन्या तं गिरा प्रत्यभाषत॥५॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said Having obtained that best of bows (Gandiva) and the couple of inexhaustible quivers and the car and the (ape standard) flagstaff, Arjuna spoke to Yudhishthira thus.

verses.sanskrit: स्वस्ति वाच्यार्हतो विप्रान्प्रयाहि भरतर्षभ। दुर्हृदामप्रहर्षाय सुहृदां नन्दनाय च॥६॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said Having obtained that best of bows (Gandiva) and the couple of inexhaustible quivers and the car and the (ape standard) flagstaff, Arjuna spoke to Yudhishthira thus.

verses.sanskrit: विजयस्ते ध्रुवं पार्थ प्रियं काममवाप्स्यसि। इत्युक्तः प्रययौ पार्थः सैन्येन महता वृतः॥७॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said Having obtained that best of bows (Gandiva) and the couple of inexhaustible quivers and the car and the (ape standard) flagstaff, Arjuna spoke to Yudhishthira thus.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निदत्तेन दिव्येन रथेनाद्भुतकर्मणा। तथैव भीमसेनोऽपि यमौ च पुरुषर्षभौ॥८॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said Having obtained that best of bows (Gandiva) and the couple of inexhaustible quivers and the car and the (ape standard) flagstaff, Arjuna spoke to Yudhishthira thus.

verses.sanskrit: ससैन्याः प्रययुः सर्वे धर्मराजेन पूजिताः। दिशं धनपतेरिष्टामजयत्पाकशासनिः॥९॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said Having obtained that best of bows (Gandiva) and the couple of inexhaustible quivers and the car and the (ape standard) flagstaff, Arjuna spoke to Yudhishthira thus.

verses.sanskrit: भीमसेनस्तथा प्राची सहदेवस्तु दक्षिणाम्। प्रतीचीं नकुलो राजन्दिशं व्यजयतास्त्रवित्॥१०॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said Having obtained that best of bows (Gandiva) and the couple of inexhaustible quivers and the car and the (ape standard) flagstaff, Arjuna spoke to Yudhishthira thus.

verses.sanskrit: खाण्डवप्रस्थमध्यस्थो धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। आसीत्परमया लक्ष्म्या सुहृद्गणवृतः प्रभुः॥११॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said Having obtained that best of bows (Gandiva) and the couple of inexhaustible quivers and the car and the (ape standard) flagstaff, Arjuna spoke to Yudhishthira thus.
